source_resemblance_review.target: GTSIO-520-H crankshaft forging, Figure A-4-20 part 41
source_resemblance_review.reference: X-30045A A-4-18 PDF38; construction A-3-1/2 PDF16-17; A-10-3 PDF70; Table 11 PDF117

findings.observation: The drawing shows projecting two-hole blades. The first forging has only rounded capsule webs.
findings.evidence_status: figure-supported construction; cheek positions corroborated by Table 11
findings.confidence: high for presence, limited for dimensions
findings.operation: Add two integral blade profiles to each middle cheek 2,5,8 and cut the paired axial bushing seats.
findings.dimension_provenance: Blade outline, spacing and bare host bore are estimates. Table 6 bushing ID is not substituted for host bore diameter.
findings.expected_visual_effect: Restore projecting tabs and twelve negative-space openings visible in the source construction.

findings.observation: Equal-radius, flat capsule webs give the candidate a stack-of-plates appearance unlike the differentiated forging in the drawing.
findings.operation: Use unequal main-journal/crankpin envelope profiles for outer cheeks and a separate middle-web profile; refine against sections or measured photographs.
findings.dimension_provenance: Documented journal/pin diameters retained. Margins and forging contour remain inferred.
findings.expected_visual_effect: More plausible boss-to-web proportions and distinct middle cheeks.
findings.disposition: support profiles recalculated in revision 4; exact forging contour remains unresolved

findings.feature: Blade thickness and counterweight fork relationship
findings.observation: Revision 2 extruded the blades at the full cheek thickness. The user's design review and A-4-30 section identify the thinner central support that the counterweight fork straddles.
findings.confidence: high for the relative relationship; exact widths unresolved
findings.operation: Use a separate blade-width parameter, centre the blade in the middle cheek, and later fit the fork slot and end clearance around it.
findings.dimension_provenance: Revision 4: blade width 0.60 of estimated cheek width = 8.4/14 mm; centered; exact fork slot remains unknown.
findings.expected_visual_effect: Reproduce the thinner flange and available space on its two axial sides.
interface_checks: saved blade-wall span less than cheek width
fork fit pending actual counterweight geometry

findings.feature: Inclined cheek faces with retained machined support lands
findings.observation: Revision 2 changed the outline but retained uniform extruded faces; it did not express the slightly tapered three-dimensional web surfaces.
findings.evidence_status: user design observation and figure-supported construction hypothesis
findings.confidence: medium; angle and precise contours unresolved
findings.operation: Use native ruled loft sections for the outer webs, retain full-depth circular pin/journal lands, and measure actual surface angles and side clearance.
findings.dimension_provenance: Revision 4: taper scale 0.15 of cheek width = 2.10 mm; contained inclined sections give about 0.6984 degrees per face.
findings.expected_visual_effect: Inclined forged-web surfaces while retaining machined interface stations.
findings.disposition: refined_in_revision_4: no negative inset into journals; full-size lands and roots checked

findings.observation: The drawing shows rounded forging/journal transitions; candidate intersections remain abrupt.
findings.operation: Add native CAD fillets/radiused shoulder features with a source-backed or explicitly estimated radius, retaining the bearing land and rod clearance.
findings.dimension_provenance: Calculated estimates: main root 0.75 of selected main margin, about 1.50 mm; pin root 0.60 of selected pin margin, about 1.71 mm. Manufacturer radii unknown.
findings.expected_visual_effect: Replace sharp plate/cylinder junctions with coherent forging transitions.
findings.disposition: implemented_in_revision_4: twelve pin and six main roots, native radius propagation and saved surfaces checked

findings.observation: Several circular features in the illustration may be recesses, drilling ends or view-dependent pin faces. Their through depth and internal routes are not established.
findings.evidence_status: figure-supported presence; blind topology and depth are explicitly authorized estimates
findings.operation: Represent the visible pin-end features as authorized estimated blind recesses, retain closed floors, and obtain a part drawing before claiming their actual purpose or internal oil routes.
findings.dimension_provenance: Radius 0.16 of documented pin diameter (9.14 mm); blind depth 0.25 of selected cheek width (3.50 mm). Explicit topology assumption, no oil route claim.
findings.expected_visual_effect: Correct the visible recessed features once identified.
interface_checks: real connected oil routes if claimed
pin/journal strength is outside this teaching validation
findings.disposition: revision_4_authorized_approximation: twelve blind end recesses with closed floors; internal routes remain unverified

findings.observation: Two held-out journal centres differ by up to approximately 16 px after two-point registration. Illustration perspective and estimated centre placement also contribute.
findings.evidence_status: inferred comparison, not a machining measurement
findings.operation: Calibrate the four journal stations and cheek/pin widths against a dimensioned drawing or scaled orthogonal measurements before changing the shared engine datum.
findings.dimension_provenance: Axial widths remain estimated; interpreted source landmark placement uncertainty is approximately 8 px.
findings.expected_visual_effect: Correct bay and end proportions without hiding errors in camera fitting.

visible_feature_checks.scope: Confirms paired openings, thinner blade sections and actual inclined web faces in saved CAD. Sizes/angle remain inferred; actual counterweight-fork fit, strength and manufacturing fidelity are not certified.

checks.check: all split liners have two conical edge reliefs

crankshaft_rebuild_checks.scope: Confirms the estimated geometry and saved feature behaviour. No manufacturer radius, hidden drilling, stress or motion claim.
